How visits work

A visit shaped around your centre.

Your team knows the residents and the rhythm of the day. We bring the dental expertise. Before a visit takes place, we agree on the care, timing, and practical arrangements together.

Discuss your centre ↗See the five stages ↓
First conversationVisit dayWhat follows

From first contact to follow-up

Five stages. One shared plan.

Each stage answers a practical question before the next one begins.

  1. 01

    Is the service a good fit?

    Tell us about your centre

    Share your location, the residents you hope to support, and the questions your team needs answered.

    Conversation
  2. 02

    What can happen on site?

    Agree on the visit plan

    We discuss suitable days, timing, facilities, and the dental care that may be appropriate at your centre.

    Planning
  3. 03

    What needs to be ready?

    Prepare residents and staff

    Your team coordinates the residents and practical arrangements agreed for the visit day.

    Preparation
  4. 04

    What happens during the visit?

    Welcome the dental team

    Our dentists and assistants provide the agreed examinations and suitable straightforward treatment on site.

    Visit day
  5. 05

    What happens afterwards?

    Discuss the next step

    We discuss further care when it is needed and consider future visits with your centre.

    Follow-up

Before visit day

The practical details are agreed together.

Every centre works differently. The first conversation is where we clarify what the visit needs and what your team can expect.

We discussResidents' needs
We agreeDays and timing
We clarifyFacilities and care scope
We confirmThe visit arrangement

A clear scope

Know what the visit can cover.

Our mobile team visits for dental examinations and straightforward treatment. The exact care available depends on each resident's needs and the facilities at the centre.

When care cannot be completed on site, we discuss what should happen next.
